installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Purpur installation script for Pterodactyl
# Server files: /mnt/server

set -eu

PROJECT="purpur"
API="https://api.purpurmc.org/v2/${PROJECT}"

cd /mnt/server

if [ -n "${DL_PATH:-}" ]; then
    echo "Using supplied download URL: ${DL_PATH}"
    DOWNLOAD_URL="${DL_PATH}"
else
    echo "Fetching ${PROJECT} version information..."

    if ! PROJECT_JSON="$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 --connect-timeout 15 "${API}")"; then
        echo "ERROR: Unable to reach the Purpur API." >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    MINECRAFT_VERSION="${MINECRAFT_VERSION:-latest}"
    BUILD_NUMBER="${BUILD_NUMBER:-latest}"

    if [ "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
        MINECRAFT_VERSION="$(printf '%s' "${PROJECT_JSON}" | jq -r '.versions[-1]')"
        echo "Using the latest Minecraft version: ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
    elif printf '%s' "${PROJECT_JSON}" | jq -e --arg version "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" '.versions | index($version) != null' >/dev/null; then
        echo "Using Minecraft version: ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
    else
        MINECRAFT_VERSION="$(printf '%s' "${PROJECT_JSON}" | jq -r '.versions[-1]')"
        echo "Requested version was not found. Using the latest version: ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
    fi

    if ! VERSION_JSON="$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 --connect-timeout 15 "${API}/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}")"; then
        echo "ERROR: Unable to fetch builds for Minecraft ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}." >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    if [ "${BUILD_NUMBER}" = "latest" ]; then
        BUILD_NUMBER="$(printf '%s' "${VERSION_JSON}" | jq -r '.builds.latest')"
        echo "Using the latest build: ${BUILD_NUMBER}"
    elif printf '%s' "${VERSION_JSON}" | jq -e --arg build "${BUILD_NUMBER}" '.builds.all | index($build) != null' >/dev/null; then
        echo "Using build: ${BUILD_NUMBER}"
    else
        BUILD_NUMBER="$(printf '%s' "${VERSION_JSON}" | jq -r '.builds.latest')"
        echo "Requested build was not found. Using the latest build: ${BUILD_NUMBER}"
    fi

    DOWNLOAD_URL="${API}/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}/${BUILD_NUMBER}/download"

    echo "Minecraft version: ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
    echo "Build: ${BUILD_NUMBER}"
    echo "Download URL: ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
fi

echo "Downloading Purpur to ${SERVER_JARFILE}..."

TMP_JAR="${SERVER_JARFILE}.tmp"
rm -f "${TMP_JAR}"

if ! curl -fSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 --connect-timeout 15 -o "${TMP_JAR}" "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"; then
    echo "ERROR: Failed to download the Purpur jar." >&2
    rm -f "${TMP_JAR}"
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -s "${TMP_JAR}" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: The downloaded jar is empty." >&2
    rm -f "${TMP_JAR}"
    exit 1
fi

if [ -f "${SERVER_JARFILE}" ]; then
    mv -f "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "${SERVER_JARFILE}.old"
fi

mv -f "${TMP_JAR}" "${SERVER_JARFILE}"
echo "Purpur installed successfully."

if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
    echo "Downloading the default server.properties..."
    if ! curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 -o server.properties \
        https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs/main/minecraft/java/server.properties; then
        echo "WARNING: Could not download server.properties. Purpur will create it on first start."
        rm -f server.properties
    fi
fi
